{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "asked for description clarifications and noted global xpub utility for non-HWI flows"
    },
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to multisig-only restriction, MuSig omission, and interface design"
    },
    {
      "login": "fametrano",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "offered a rebased branch addressing achow101's comments"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5576284918",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Restricts global xpubs to multisig descriptors instead of handling descriptors and PSBTs generically",
      "quote": "PSBTs and Descriptors are generic objects, we should avoid doing things that are specific to one type of descriptor or psbt.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3952940430",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Return the map directly rather than taking it as an output parameter",
      "quote": "This should return the map rather than taking it as an output parameter.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3952940430",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Do not pass SigningProvider since the last hardened key is either cached or does not exist",
      "quote": "Do not provide `SigningProvider`, either the last hardened key is already cached, or it does not exist. There is no need to take a `SigningProvider` here, otherwise the wallet wouldn't function.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3952954577",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Makes assumptions about caller usage instead of returning the root and its fingerprint when normalized keys cannot be obtained",
      "quote": "We should not make assumptions about what the caller is going to use the xpubs for. This should return the root and it's fingerprint for any key where we cannot do the normalized key thing.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3952964673",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Query the cache directly and return the root if missing, rather than calculating the last hardened index",
      "quote": "It is not necessary to determine what the last hardened index is, just ask the cache for it, and if the cache doesn't have that key, return the root.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3952968998",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "MuSig descriptors omit participant extended public keys",
      "quote": "This is incorrect. It should traverse the participants and get their xpubs.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "address achow101's review feedback and objections",
      "id": "c:5576284918"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Brought claims up to date with schema 2: rc:3952940430 was split into two suggestions (returning the map directly and omitting SigningProvider), and rc:3952964673 was converted from an objection to a suggestion. fametrano added as neutral participant after offering a branch implementing the requested changes."
}
